# Can you wait eight years for the first sale?

> Free Christmas tree farm profit calculator. Plant blocks each year, wait 7-10 years, and see cash flow, payback, NPV and the price per tree you need to break even. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
